book.name: Mako
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Mako

content: Yesu palongi jaka Pilato
Palukela pakwachaje, bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa bhakahimangini papamu na bhazee, bhabhola bha Shelia na bhabholu bha pachengu pokapi, bhakunkongiki Yesu, na bhakumpeliki kwaka Pilato.
Pilato akundaluki Yesu, “Bho, wehapa le Unkolongwa wa Bhayahude?” Yesu akayangike, “Wehapa upwaghike.”
Bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa bhakuntaki Yesu kwa malobhi ghamaheli.
Pilato akundaluki kabheti Yesu, “Bho, ngacheuyanga lilobhi? Lingalyaje ntundu mobhaletela matakilu ghamaheli panani jako!”
Nambu Yesu ngacheakayangiki lilobhi, mbaka Pilato akakangiche.
Yesu bhuntemu kupotela
Pilato akabhi na ntetu chikahi cha Uwangalalu wa Pasaka kumbopulela mkongeka jumu, jobhundobha bhandu.
Chikahi hechi mundu jumu joalowakika Balaba, akakongakiki pandu pabhakongeka bhandu kwa ndandi ja kutumbuli ngondo na kubhakoma bhandu bhangi.
Lipogha la bhandu lakunjendi Pilato, na kundobha abhahengila ngati mowabheli ntetu wake.
Pilato akabhalalukile, “Bho, mpala numbopulya Nkolongwa wa Bhayahude?”
Ndandi jombi akamanyiki kubha bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa bhakunkamwi Yesu kwa ndandi ja wihu.
Nambu bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa bhakabhaswekaki bhandu nahuli bhundobha abhabhopulya Balaba bhunkonga Yesu.
Pilato akabhalaluki kabheti bhandu, “Bho, mpala nepani ndenda kyani na mundu jonjoni jomundoa Nkolongwa wa Bhayahude?”
Bhandu bhokapi bhakajamali bhakapwaghaje, “Unhwamba punsalaba!”
Nambu Pilato akabhalalukile, “Bho, maghambu kike? Bho, ahengiki lihakau bhole?” Nambu bhombi bhakajendali kujamalila, “Unhwamba punsalaba!”
Pilato akapaliki kubhahekeha bhandu bhala, bhela akumbopuli Balaba. Akalaghalaki Yesu alapulika iboku, na kumboha nahuli awambakikaje punsalaba.
Manjolinjoli bhundongama Yesu
Manjolinjoli bhakumpeliki Yesu mu liwangala la mkati la nyumba jaka Pilato, yani Pulaitolio, na kubhaloha lipogha lokapi la manjolinjoli.
Bhakamuwatiki ingobhu ja zambalau ngati Nkolongwa, bhakalokiki litaji la miha na kunhwatika kumutu.
Bhakatumbwi kundamukila kwa kundongama, “Monili ote, Unkolongwa wa Bhayahude!”
Bhakundapwi kwa ndahi kumuto, na kunhuni imata. Bhakachikimi na kunjojabhela.
Pabhajomwi kundongama, bhakunhuliki ingobhu ja zambalau jela, na kunhwatika ingobhu yaki mweni yela. Bhakumpihiki kunja nahuli kumpeleka kunhwamba punsalaba.
Yesu bhunhwamba punsalaba

Pabhakabhi mwindela bhakahimangini na mundu jumu joalowakika Simoni, akabhi ahika kuhuma ku Kilene, jombi akabhi atati waka Alekizanda na Lufo. Na chikahi hechi akabhi ahuma kunja ja muchi, na manjolinjoli bhakumpwaghi kwa amuli atotulaje nsalaba ghoakabhi naku Yesu.
Bhela bhakumpeliki Yesu mbaka pa Goligota, yani “Lifuvu la Mmutu.”
Panihapa bhakumpeki divai jebhahangaghini na mitela jejilowakeka manemane, nambu Yesu ngacheanywile.
Bhela bhakunhwambiki na kughabhana ingobhu yaki kwa kuilapuli kula nahuli kumanya ngati ingobhu bhole jeapalika mundu kupata.
Jakabhi saa tatu ja lukela pabhunhwambikaje.
Na panani ja nsalaba bhakalembiki litakilu ale, “NKOLONGWA WA BHAYAHUDE.”
Bhela bhakunhwambiki Yesu punsalaba papamu na bhanyaghula bhangi bhabhele, jumu upambala wa kumalelelu na jongi upambala wa kumangeja.
Bhela Malembu Mahuhu ghakatimiye ghaghapwagha, “Akabhalangiki papamu na bhandu bhahakau.”

Bhandu bhabhapetika pandu panihapa bhakundongali matondo, bhakanyuanyua mimutu jabhu kwa kundongama, bhakapwaghaje, “Aha! Wehapa upwaghika wibhombula Nyumba jaka Chapanga na kuchenga kwa machobha ghatatu!
Henu, uhuluka punsalaba na ulikengalya wamwete!”
Na bhombi bhapenganyambiku bhakolongwa papamu na bhabhola bha Shelia bhakundongimi pachilanda jabhu, bhakapwaghaje, “Akabhalamihi bhangi, nambu ngacheaweza kulikengale mwene!
Eti jombi nde Kristo, Nkolongwa wa ku Izilaeli! Henu ahuluka kuhuma pansalaba nahuli tubhonaje na kuhobhalela.” Hata bhandu bhabhawambakiki pambipi na Yesu bhala bhakundongali matondo.
Yesu apotela punsalaba
Kutumbu saa sita, mbaka saa tisa ja muhi, lubhendu lukayekiki inchi jokapi.
Saa tisa ja muhi Yesu akajamalili, akapwaghaje, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabakitani,” ndandi jaki, “Chapanga wangu, Chapanga wangu, mbona unehile?”
Bhandu bhangi bhabhajemani panipala pabhakajowini ghanihagha, bhakapwaghike, “Jowanyaje! Andoha Eliya!”

Mundu jumu akakembili, akatobhali siponji mkati ja divai jejilolike, na kukongale kumwishu ja ndahi. Akumbeki pundomu akapwaghaje, “Mundeka tulolaje ngati Eliya anahika kunheleha kuhuma punsalaba hapa!”
Yesu akajamalili kwa sauti nkolongwa, na kuheketa roho.
Chikahi hechi lipanzia lelabhi mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga lakakachwiki ipambala ibheli kutumbu kunani mbaka pahi.
Nkolongwa jumu wa manjolinjoli joakajemiki palongi jaki paakaweni kubha Yesu apotela ngati bhenibhela, akapwaghike, “Chakaka mundu ajoju akabhi Mwana waka Chapanga!”
Bhakabhi kabheti akambomba bhangi cha kutali bhakalingalyaje, papuje akabhi Malia Magidalena, na Malia mabhu waka Yakobo na Yose, na Salome.
Akamabhu bhanihabha bhakunjengali Yesu ku Galilaya na kunjangatila. Akamabhu bhangi bhamaheli bhabhunjengali Yesu mbaka ku Yelusalemu na bhombi bhakabhi palapala.
Hyegha jaka Yesu bhajibheka mulitengele
Pakwahiki pakamihi, lichobha heli lakabhi Lichobha la Maandaliu, yani lichobha lelilongulela mangani ja Lichobha la Sabato.

Panihapa akahiki Yusufu mundu wa ku Alimataya, mbolu wa Pachengu Pakolongwa joakamanyakini namaa. Na jombi akabhi alendalela kuhika kwa Ukolongwa waka Chapanga. Akunjendi Pilato panga choghohi na kunjopa ampekya hyegha jaka Yesu.
Pilato akakangichi kujowana kubha Yesu akabhi apotile. Bhela akunkemiki nkolongwa wa manjolinjoli, na kundalukila ngati Yesu akapoti chikahi chilacho.
Pilato paakunjowini linjolinjoli jola kubha Yesu apotile, akunjetaki Yusufu atola hyegha jaka Yesu.

Panihapa Yusufu wa ku Alimataya akahemi sanda, akajiheli hyegha jaka Yesu, akajiyongalwi sanda. Akajibhehi mulitengele lelalenganakiki pa liganga. Kabheti akahingali liganga likolongwa na kuhibhali pundyangu wa litengele.
Na jombi Malia Magidalena na Malia mabhu waka Yose bhakabhi bhalingalila na kupabhona pandu pabhaghoniki hyegha jaka Yesu.
